title: Free Kick Taking Routine And Composure (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica steel guitar fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son, a free kick is a GIFT
Dont waste my gift now

[Verse 1]
Umpire signals, the crowd goes still
Free kick right in front, you have the skill
Dont rush, dont rush, the clock is yours
Take your time son, this moment is always yours

Bounce it once, feel the leather round
Eyes on the target, feet on the ground
Six point kick starts with a six point mind
Steady the nerves, leave the rush behind

[Pre-Chorus]
One breath in, one breath out
No outside noise, block the doubt
Step and drop and follow through
Free kick taken, goal for you

[Chorus]
Free kick composure, own the moment calm
Bounce it gentle, drop it on the palm
Step and swing, follow high and true
Free kick composure sees you through

[Verse 2]
If the angle is tight, aim inside the post
Twenty metres out, that is worth the most
Prefer the drop to hit on the sweet spot
Never rush your own kick with a hurried shot

[Bridge]
Bluey: AND HE LINES IT UP, the crowd is silent at the G
Trevor: Technically, his drop point was perfect, about hip height
Chas: I told him hip height since he was nine

[Chorus]
Free kick composure, own the moment calm
Bounce it gentle, drop it on the palm
Step and swing, follow high and true
Free kick composure sees you through

[Outro]
Routine under pressure son
Thats my boy
